mechanism_narrative: A high level of non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the periods when PAYEMS exceeds 150,000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals an overheating labor market that may prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the periods following a UNRATE drop below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and a low unemployment rate (below 3.5%) signals an accommodative monetary policy combined with a tight labor market, which supports economic growth and equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the periods when FEDFUNDS declines and UNRATE is below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), a strong labor market (high PAYEMS) signals that the economy is resilient to rate hikes, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the months when PAYEMS is above 150,000.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing and supply chain activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the periods when INDPRO increases from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the annual rate of consumer price inflation above 2.5% signals potential monetary policy tightening by the Federal Reserve, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the periods when the annual CPIAUCSL rate exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand and economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1200 thousand units signals a weakening housing market and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the periods when HOUST is below 1200.
